deviations: Alert and Inline notice tone axis has 6 values: the spec 5 plus important (important/* roles), per the brief.

Alert/Inline notice/Toast label is a per-variant text layer (tone type: Note, Info, Success, Warning, Error, Important), not a TEXT property: verified that binding a TEXT property overwrites every variant with one default. Override the text in the instance for a custom title.

No iconGlyph swap property on Alert/Inline notice: verified that binding an INSTANCE_SWAP property (and swapping any variant afterwards) resets every variant to one default glyph. Each tone carries its own glyph; swap the nested glyph instance directly.

Alert: description T.body (spec T.small); padding space/card/padding on all sides and gap space/control/gap (spec 8/12, which equals a compact notice); icon box = type/strong/line, glyph size/icon/md; body indented 26 px (box 20 + gap 6) to the label.
Alert strong rule for important = important/text (no important/default role exists); neutral and info marker/default, others <tone>/default as spec.

Inline notice: <tone>/subtle fill (owner content-colour note) instead of the spec surface/surface; label T.strong-sm, description T.small; trailing link action; padding space/stack/gap x space/control/padding-x.

Toast: spec eyebrow prop dropped (owner header rule: one label). Status types use <tone>/subtle + <tone>/border + <tone>/text (owner content-colour note) on top of R.float; default and loading keep surface/raised + border/default. Padding space/card/padding (code space-4 = 16; spec space/stack/gap = 8). Timer track <tone>/border (default/loading border/default) and bar <tone>/text (default/loading text/fg) instead of material/track + <tone>/default, so the bar reads on tinted fills.

Progress primary bar = marker/default and secondary = secondary/text (spec <v>/default): primary/default is graphite #313131 in Utility dark and secondary/default is gray 3, both invisible on material/track.
Progress value is the track padding (instance-overridable) rather than a fixed bar width: Figma does not allow resizing layers inside instances.
Progress circular is a new set (the brief asks for circular; the code and spec have none): literal diameters 24/40/64 and strokes 3/4/6.
Spinner extended with tone (6) x size (3) = 18; primary arc marker/default (was primary/default, invisible in Utility dark), statuses <tone>/text, neutral text/muted; round cap per spec.

Skeleton shape values line | block | avatar (spec circle): radius/avatar, so it is square in Utility like the Avatar it stands for. Block heights bound to space/control/height-sm | height | height-lg. No shimmer layer: static frames show the resting bone (reduced motion).

Empty state adds type first-use | no-results | error (brief) to the spec media x size: 18 variants; media image = illustration .Slot swap; primary + secondary actions exposed with actions and secondaryAction booleans.
Important tone glyph = Icon/bell (the 51-glyph set has no message-square-warning; Foundations left untouched).
Badge solid light values kept as instructed although info (3.26:1), success (3.03:1) and destructive (3.91:1) are below 4.5:1 with white labels.

audit.typeVarsFromCoordinator: no text on the page uses font/mono at caption size or font/label with strong weight, so type/mono/style and type/label-strong/style have no consumers here

perSet.Spinner: 18 variants, 54 nodes; literals: stroke weights 2/3 (spec lit)
perSet.Skeleton: 12 variants; 0 literal paints/spacing; size literals = code rem heights

ownerNotes: Callout/alert header rule applied to Alert, Inline notice and Toast: one label (icon + tone type or custom title, <tone>/text, Medium, body size, sentence case), no mono eyebrow, icon box = label line height centred on the first line, body indented to the label left edge.

Content colour: status tones (subtle fill + border + text) on alerts, notices and toasts; red only in the destructive tone (Alert/Notice destructive, Toast error, Empty state error, Progress destructive).
Dark is designed: Utility dark toasts are raised graphite (#222225), status fills are deep tints, solid badges use deep-tone pairs, primary indicators flip to light ink.

Theme character / style pass: language anatomy for Feedback (Tonal wavy progress, Brutal pink slab alert, Pixel banded bar, Terminal level column, Tactile meter/LED) is not built here; it belongs to the per-theme style sets.
